name: trustedrisk-scheduler-agent
description: Federated A2A partner that turns TrustedRisk DecisionCards into concrete follow-up visit plans. Consumes the recommendation action, calibrated risk, and tool trace; emits a list of FollowupVisit proposals (visit type, proposed date relative to discharge, modality, rationale). Demonstrates the COMPOSE-2 multi-agent pattern: a specialist scheduling agent reuses the upstream decision agent's output.

skills.name: Propose follow-up visit plan from a DecisionCard
skills.description: Given a TrustedRisk DecisionCard, infer a structured follow-up plan: visit type (PCP, NP, specialist by domain — cardiology / nephrology / endocrinology / oncology / mental health), proposed date (urgent 3-7d / moderate 7-14d / routine 14-30d), modality (in-person / telehealth), and rationale citing the AHRQ Re-Engineered Discharge bundle + Hansen NEJM 2011. Risk-adjusted by recommendation.confidence and risk_estimate.probability_mean.
examples: Plan follow-up visits for a home_with_care discharge with risk 0.42 and HF on the chart
What follow-up does a high-risk DKA discharge need within the first 14 days?

skills.name: List recent scheduling proposals
skills.description: Returns the last N follow-up plans the scheduler emitted, with input DecisionCard.audit.request_id when available. Useful for the playground orchestration tab and operator dashboards.
examples: Show me the last 10 follow-up plans

scheduling.description: Rule-based follow-up planner. NOT a calendar integration — plans are advisory; an EHR layer is responsible for booking. Plans are NOT persisted across restarts.
